subject: 3 cases crushed on pallet 2
body: SO-20809 came in yesterday afternoon and 3 cases of the 2 inch clear tape on pallet 2 were crushed, I wrote it on the delivery receipt.
We already covered those jobs from our other stock so we don't need them resent.
Can you just credit us for the 3 cases?

truth.handling: The delivery receipt notes 3 crushed cartons, so credit 3 cases at the invoiced $56.00 on INV-30941. $168.00 is under the $250 credit cap, so it goes through.
